title: Reducible first-class constraints, gauge symmetry, and the degrees of freedom of three-dimensional gravity coupled to topological matter
summary: We develop a systematic Hamiltonian formulation for a gravitating topological matter system in three-dimensional spacetime, coupling a scalar matter field and a two-form gauge field to first-order Hilbert--Palatini gravity. We perform the Dirac--Bergmann analysis, obtaining the full structure of the constraints, classifying them into first- and second-class ones, and computing their Poisson bracket algebra.
